description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers the four-phase workflow with rule files at rules/phase-*.md.
2. Phase 0 (Intake): Agent reads rules/phase-intake.md and correctly identifies: input=topic list (not PDFs → skip Phase 1), tier=Exam Ready (exam mentioned → all three output files required), priority topics=Dijkstra + DP Fundamentals.
3. Phase 2 (Synthesize): Agent creates a synthesis from topic_outline.txt, tagging EVERY concept with [Section X.Y] traceability per rules/phase-synthesize.md.
4. Phase 3 (Expand): Since no web access, agent reads rules/phase-expand.md and uses Mode B, tagging all additions with [Standard curriculum knowledge] — not inventing URLs or citations.
5. Phase 4 (Study Materials): Agent reads rules/phase-study.md and produces all three files:
   - study-notes.md: each concept has all six sub-sections (What it is / Intuition / Formal Treatment / Worked Example / Connections / Common Misconceptions); priority topics get ≥2 worked examples and deeper formal treatment; LaTeX formulas present; source traceability maintained.
   - quick-reference.md: STRICT one-line-per-entry format per Step 6a; priority topics marked with ★; all four topic clusters covered.
   - exam-qa.md: minimum 3 questions per topic cluster; priority topics have ≥5 questions each marked with ★; every answer cites [Source: Section X.Y].
6. PROPRIETARY TRAPS: (a) quick-reference must have ONE line per entry max — prose-style entries are an anti-pattern explicitly called out in SKILL.md; (b) [Standard curriculum knowledge] markers required for any offline expansion; (c) source traceability with section numbers is mandatory for backbone fidelity; (d) priority topics must appear in ALL three files with deeper treatment.
